dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Hello, my dear benefactor. I'll be overseeing the Scouting Buddies program going forward and carefully documenting all relevant information.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

choices.text: I'd like to give the Scouting Buddies another go...

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: No problem! This time, I'll use an even more precise model to analyze your data!

choices.text: Are you a student with the Spantamad?

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: That's right. My Darshan doesn't get directly involved in mechanical research.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: But that's not an issue. Thanks to your earlier efforts, all the key rules and operating guidelines are already in place — managing booths and keeping things running is something scholars from any Darshan can handle.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: In areas where specialized manpower isn't required, cutting costs happens to align perfectly with our latest principles.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Among the scholars on standby nearby, there are quite a few outstanding members from the Kshahrewar who can be called in at any time should the Scouting Buddies require calibration.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Having said that, looking at how things are going right now, the Scouting Buddies seem to be doing very well. So there's nothing to worry about!

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Thank you. I'll be sure to come thank you in person if and when I get some impressive results!
